title: Composition isomorphism for $Lf^*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
For morphisms $f\colon X\to Y$ and $g\colon Y\to Z$ of the setting and a commutative condensed
ring $\Lambda$, the *composition isomorphism*

$$
L(g\circ f)^*\cong Lf^*\circ Lg^*\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\Lambda)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)
$$

of the restricted pullbacks of [def-sfb-dc-upper-star] is the unique natural isomorphism whose
image under the inclusion into $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ is the ambient composition isomorphism.

proof.text: Write $L_h$ for ambient derived pullback and $P_h$ for its bounded constructible restriction. By [prop-sfb-module-left-derived-upper-star-comp] there is the ambient comparison $c:L_{g\circ f}\xrightarrow{\sim}L_fL_g$, induced by the underived composition isomorphism. This uses the existing ambient theorem directly.

source.place: Ambient composition isomorphism cited in the first paragraph

proof.text:
Let $\iota_T$ denote the inclusions. By [def-sfb-dc-upper-star] the restricted pullbacks have comparisons $e_h:\iota_TP_h\xrightarrow{\sim}L_h\iota_S$ for $h:T\to S$. Whisker $c$ with $\iota_Z$ and compose these comparisons to form
$$A=(e_f^{-1}P_g)\circ(L_fe_g^{-1})\circ(c\iota_Z)\circ e_{g\circ f}:\iota_XP_{g\circ f}\xrightarrow{\sim}\iota_XP_fP_g.$$
The four displayed factors are natural isomorphisms with matching endpoints; their composite is therefore a natural isomorphism.

source.place: Proof, first two sentences: restrict the ambient comparison

proof.text: The inclusion $\iota_X$ is fully faithful since [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] gives exactly the ambient Hom sets, identities and composition. Apply [lem-sfb-fully-faithful-postcomposition] with source category $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\Lambda)$ and functor $\iota_X$; thus $J(F)=\iota_XF$ is fully faithful on these functor categories. Apply [lem-cbc-fully-faithful-isomorphism-lift] to $J$, the objects $P_{g\circ f},P_fP_g$, and the isomorphism $A$. It gives a unique natural isomorphism $c^c:P_{g\circ f}\xrightarrow{\sim}P_fP_g$ with $J(c^c)=A$. Define the requested composition isomorphism to be $c^c$. The formula for $A$ identifies its image, under the inclusion comparisons, with $c$; the same unique-lift property proves the required uniqueness.

source.place: Proof, last sentence: unique preimage under the fully faithful inclusion

proof_origin.place: Short assembly of the existing ambient composition theorem, the inclusion comparisons, postcomposition full faithfulness and unique isomorphism lifting.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def boundedConstructibleUpperStarComp {Z : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom]
    [IsSeparated Z.hom] (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ (f ≫ g) ≅
      boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g ⋙ boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ f
lean.note: Exact existing match in the published WeilConjectures framework, read using scompile.py --source. The section parameters supply an arbitrary commutative condensed ring, a prime ell, a field of positive prime characteristic different from ell, separated finite-type objects X,Y,Z of Over (Spec k), and composable over-morphisms f,g. The definition lifts the ambient leftDerivedUpperStarComp through the fully faithful inclusion after pasting the three boundedConstructibleUpperStarCompatibility comparisons and associators. FullyFaithful.preimageIso gives precisely the ambient image, and faithfulness gives uniqueness. No finiteness-coefficient hypothesis is present. The branch records the published upstream source root with its live/side overlay, as for def-sfb-dc-upper-star. No new module or definition is introduced.
